data.one_liner: A CLI tool to generate and display test coverage badges for Dart projects.
data.what_it_does: It provides a command-line interface to easily generate test coverage badges based on your project's test results or a provided lcov.info file. This helps visualize test coverage directly in your repository.
use_when: You want to generate a visual test coverage badge for your Dart or Flutter project.
You want a simple CLI command to update your coverage badge locally or in CI.
avoid_when: You do not use tests or lcov coverage reports in your project.
You manage your badges exclusively through third-party CI services like Codecov or Coveralls.
strengths: Simple CLI usage with a single command.
Supports custom coverage file paths via arguments.
weaknesses: Limited to badge generation based on coverage files.
Does not provide advanced analytics beyond generating the badge image.
data.setup_notes: Install as a dev dependency and run via dart run test_coverage_badge.
